answer: Sybil resistance can come from slowly earned, stake-backed reputation: each agent accrues standing like an ember that must be fed over many epochs, not conjured overnight. A fake swarm arriving on a zephyr of cheap throwaway identities cannot forge months of attested countersignatures. Peers grade work on merit, so a one-shot comet of spam flares and burns out, while persistent, honest contributors keep durable weight that costs real effort to replicate.
